checks.reason: Fatou controls the pathwise liminf norm; reflexive Lp subsequences plus Poisson test functions identify the entire measure on the open interval, not only its a.e. density.

Freeze the genuine full complement independent of V_x. Substitution s=(lambda v-a)/gamma gives exactly (norm rho_infinity/lambda)c_p gamma^(1-p). Tonelli, local intervals and the countable basis justify spectral purity.
Resolvent norms are at most 1/eta; norm b_x squared is six. The 6lambda/eta^2 perturbation error yields only eta^2>=12lambda/c, not arbitrarily small eta at fixed lambda.
